auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Framejet API key sent as the X-Api-Key header. Create a free key (200 screenshots a month) at https://framejet.dev.

actions.name: create_signed_url
actions.description: Build a signed capture URL that can be embedded where the API key must stay secret. Nothing is captured until the URL is loaded.

url.description: The public http or https page to capture.

format.description: The image format. Defaults to png.

full_page.description: Whether to capture the whole scrollable page instead of the viewport.

width.description: The viewport width in pixels. Defaults to 1280.

height.description: The viewport height in pixels. Defaults to 800.

dpr.description: The device pixel ratio. Defaults to 1.

clean.description: Whether to remove cookie banners, consent walls and chat widgets before the capture. Defaults to true.

delay.description: An extra wait in milliseconds after the page loads.

actions.description: Up to 10 steps, with at most 15 seconds of waiting in total, to run before the capture, separated by semicolons: click:<css>, type:<css>=<text>, waitfor:<css>, wait:<ms> or scroll:<px>. Example: click:#accept;waitfor:.pricing

expires_in.description: Seconds until the URL stops working. Omit it for a URL that never expires.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for building a signed Framejet capture URL.

signed_url.description: A capture URL that works in an img src, a CMS or a spreadsheet without exposing the API key. The first load spends one screenshot. Framejet serves later loads from its cache for seven days, then captures again, so a URL that keeps being viewed costs at most about one screenshot a week.

outputSchema.description: The output payload for a signed Framejet capture URL.

actions.name: take_screenshot
actions.description: Capture a public web page as a PNG or JPEG with cookie banners and chat widgets removed, optionally after running page steps or reaching a state described in plain language.

url.description: The public http or https page to capture.

format.description: The image format. Defaults to png.

full_page.description: Whether to capture the whole scrollable page instead of the viewport.

width.description: The viewport width in pixels. Defaults to 1280.

height.description: The viewport height in pixels. Defaults to 800.

dpr.description: The device pixel ratio. Defaults to 1.

clean.description: Whether to remove cookie banners, consent walls and chat widgets before the capture. Defaults to true.

delay.description: An extra wait in milliseconds after the page loads.

actions.description: Up to 10 steps, with at most 15 seconds of waiting in total, to run before the capture, separated by semicolons: click:<css>, type:<css>=<text>, waitfor:<css>, wait:<ms> or scroll:<px>. Example: click:#accept;waitfor:.pricing

goal.description: A plain-language description of the page state to reach before the capture, ending with when to stop. Any text typed into the page must come from values. Example: switch the pricing table to yearly billing and stop when the yearly prices are shown

items.description: One exact string of at most 200 characters. It cannot contain |, which Framejet uses to separate values.

values.description: Exact strings goal mode may type into the page. Framejet never invents text, so a goal that fills a field fails with values_required unless a fitting value is listed. Joined with | separators, the list may total at most 1000 characters.

cache.description: Whether an identical earlier capture may be returned without spending a screenshot. Defaults to true.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for capturing a web page with Framejet.

downloadUrl.description: The local transit URL for downloading the image.

file.description: The captured image stored in local transit storage.

cache.description: Whether Framejet served an earlier identical capture.

anyOf.description: Screenshots left in the current month, or null when Framejet does not report it.

remaining.description: Screenshots left in the current month, or null when Framejet does not report it.

outputSchema.description: The output payload for a Framejet capture.
